title: Planner: redesigned My Tasks experience on the web
summary: The rollout, automatic enablement and PowerShell control are supported by Microsoft's notice and documentation. Qualify the Microsoft 365 entitlement statement and describe December as Microsoft's rollout window rather than a guaranteed arrival date.

claims.quote: Planner: My Tasks redesign

claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.

claims.claim: The roadmap record was modified at 2026-11-04T00:02:09.
The roadmap describes bringing tasks into one place to capture work, prioritise and stay focused.
claims.quote: A redesigned My Tasks experience that brings your tasks into one place, making it easier to capture work, prioritize what matters, and stay focused.

claims.claim: Microsoft says the redesign helps users identify, prioritise and manage work.
claims.quote: Microsoft is introducing a redesigned My Tasks experience in Planner to help users more easily identify, prioritize, and manage their work.

claims.claim: The redesign introduces clearer navigation.
claims.quote: Navigation within My Tasks will be simplified and easier to understand.

claims.claim: Task organisation and prioritisation are updated.
claims.quote: Task organization and prioritization experiences will be updated.

claims.claim: Users can create tasks through streamlined workflows without leaving their current context.
claims.quote: Users will be able to create tasks through streamlined workflows without leaving their current context.

claims.claim: Existing tasks and task data remain available.
claims.quote: Existing tasks and task data will remain available.

claims.claim: No user data movement is required.
claims.quote: No migration or user data movement is required.

claims.claim: The redesign is on by default through automatic service rollout.
claims.quote: The feature will be enabled automatically as part of the service rollout.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft requires no changes to existing admin policies or configurations.
claims.quote: No changes to existing admin policies or configurations are required.

claims.claim: Microsoft says no action is required.
claims.quote: No action is required.

claims.claim: Microsoft suggests informing helpdesk and support teams.
claims.quote: You may want to: - Inform helpdesk and support teams of the upcoming user interface changes.

claims.claim: Microsoft suggests communicating the update to regular My Tasks users.

claims.claim: Microsoft suggests reviewing and updating training materials and screenshots as needed.
claims.quote: Review any internal training materials or screenshots that reference the current experience and update them as needed.

claims.claim: Microsoft suggests monitoring user feedback during rollout and adoption.
claims.quote: Monitor user feedback during rollout and adoption.

claims.claim: MC1488844 was updated on 3 November 2026.
claims.quote: Updated November 3, 2026: We have updated the timeline.

claims.claim: Microsoft's notice gives early through late December 2026 for Worldwide General Availability rollout.
claims.quote: General Availability (Worldwide): Rollout will occur from early through late December 2026 (previously November).

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: The rollout window previously named November.
claims.quote: Rollout will occur from early through late December 2026 (previously November).

claims.claim: The notice sets no act-by date.
claims.quote: Act by: none

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe this My Tasks redesign.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner redesigned My Tasks December 2026 navigation task creation storage Teams MC1488844. Opened planner-for-admins, manage-planner-app and service description; results describe existing My Tasks, not this redesign.

claims.claim: The current My Tasks view in Planner in Teams includes Private Tasks.
claims.quote: My Tasks: This view includes: - Private Tasks: A dedicated place for the user to quickly create tasks in a default place.

claims.claim: Assigned to me includes tasks assigned from several sources.
claims.quote: Assigned to me: Shows all tasks that are assigned to the user from Teams meeting notes, Microsoft Loop, Planner, and Planner premium.

claims.claim: My Tasks in Teams includes flagged Outlook emails as tasks.
claims.quote: Flagged emails: Emails the user flagged in Outlook show up as tasks here.

claims.claim: Private tasks are stored in Exchange.
claims.quote: Private tasks and their attachments: These are stored in Microsoft Exchange.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified whether the redesign changes the task sources shown.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner redesigned My Tasks December 2026 navigation task creation storage Teams MC1488844. Read MC1488844, manage-planner-app and planner-for-admins; no redesign-specific source list.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified storage for tasks created through the new workflow.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner My Tasks web Exchange Online license hide private tasks storage redesigned; Planner redesigned My Tasks December 2026 navigation task creation storage Teams MC1488844. Read manage-planner-app and MC1488844; no new-workflow storage statement.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Neither the roadmap nor notice describes new data access, identity requirements or spend.
claims.quote: No migration or user data movement is required. - The feature will be enabled automatically as part of the service rollout. - No changes to existing admin policies or configurations are required.

claims.claim: The notice identifies no compliance considerations.
claims.quote: No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Neither the roadmap nor the notice describes autonomous task actions by the redesign.
claims.quote: Users will be able to create tasks through streamlined workflows without leaving their current context.

claims.claim: The described task management and creation workflows are user actions.
claims.quote: The updated experience provides clearer navigation, improved task organization, and streamlined task creation workflows, enabling users to create and manage tasks more efficiently without leaving their current context.

claims.claim: My Tasks is included with the qualifying Microsoft 365 licensing Planner already requires.
claims.quote: In this service description, Microsoft 365 refers to Planner capabilities included with eligible Microsoft 365 and Office 365 suites for Commercial and Academic audiences. | My Day and My Tasks | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

claims.claim: Planner for admins gives qualifying Microsoft 365 users task creation and editing capabilities.
claims.quote: Users with a qualifying Microsoft 365 license have access to a rich set of capabilities for individual and team work management. These capabilities include basic plan creation and editing capabilities, task creation and editing capabilities

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Planner for admins lists My Day and My Tasks among qualifying Microsoft 365 capabilities.
claims.quote: various plan views - including Grid, Board, Schedule, and Charts - My Day, My Tasks, and more.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The Teams article says users with a Microsoft 365 licence are entitled to the Planner app.
claims.quote: Users with a Microsoft 365 license are entitled to the Planner app.
claims.fix: Replace the unqualified entitlement sentence and corresponding licensing note with: 'Microsoft Learn lists My Day and My Tasks among the capabilities available with a qualifying Microsoft 365 licence that includes Planner.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/planner/planner-for-admins, which qualifies the entitlement and lists eligible subscriptions.

claims.claim: The supplied notice names no additional licence or charge for the redesign.
claims.quote: No action is required.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: No licence requirement specific to the redesign is published in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner My Tasks redesigned experience licensing price meter Microsoft 365. Opened planner-for-admins, manage-planner-app and service description; My Tasks has general Planner entitlement, with no redesign-specific licence.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: No price specific to the redesign is published in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner My Tasks redesigned experience licensing price meter Microsoft 365. Opened planner-for-admins, manage-planner-app and service description; no redesign-specific price.

claims.claim: No meter specific to the redesigned My Tasks is published in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner My Tasks redesigned experience licensing price meter Microsoft 365. Opened service description and Planner admin pages; My Tasks is included, and the Graph API metering footnote does not describe this UI redesign.

claims.claim: All users who access Planner and use My Tasks are affected.
claims.quote: Who is affected: - All users who access Microsoft Planner and use the My Tasks experience.

claims.claim: Whether this redesign reaches Planner in Teams is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner redesigned My Tasks December 2026 navigation task creation storage Teams MC1488844. Read roadmap Web platform, MC1488844 and manage-planner-app; none explicitly identifies this redesign as a Teams rollout.

claims.claim: The notice lists no administrator prerequisites.
claims.quote: No changes to existing admin policies or configurations are required. [Action Required/Recommendations:] No action is required.

claims.claim: Set-PlannerConfiguration -IsPlannerAllowed $false is the documented PowerShell operation to turn off Planner.
claims.quote: Turn off Planner for your organization using PowerShell ... Set-PlannerConfiguration -IsPlannerAllowed $false

claims.claim: A global admin can use the organisation-wide Planner PowerShell control.
claims.quote: If you're a global admin and you want to turn off Microsoft Planner for your organization, you can use Windows PowerShell.

claims.claim: Setting IsPlannerAllowed to $true turns Planner back on.
claims.quote: To turn on Planner back: Set-PlannerConfiguration -IsPlannerAllowed $true

claims.claim: The PowerShell control applies to basic plans in Planner in Teams and on the web.
claims.quote: This article applies to: - Basic plans in the Planner app in Teams and Web

claims.claim: The PowerShell article applies to all plans in other Planner endpoints.
claims.quote: All plans in other Planner endpoints (including Planner mobile, and Planner connectors).

claims.claim: No admin UI equivalent of the tenant-wide Planner web PowerShell switch is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner turn off organization web IsPlannerAllowed admin center UI tenant. Opened disable-planner and manage-planner-app; Teams apps > Manage apps blocks the Teams app, not the tenant-wide web IsPlannerAllowed setting.

claims.claim: No tenant UI or automation switch to defer or opt out of this My Tasks redesign is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner My Tasks redesign defer opt out admin switch PowerShell Microsoft Graph IsPlannerAllowed. Read disable-planner, manage-planner-app, Planner Graph overview and Planner PowerShell prerequisites excerpts; no redesign-specific opt-out operation.

claims.claim: The organisation-wide PowerShell switch turns off Planner rather than only the redesign.
claims.quote: If you're a global admin and you want to turn off Microsoft Planner for your organization, you can use Windows PowerShell.

claims.claim: The Teams article documents hiding a user's My Tasks by removing their Exchange Online licence.
claims.quote: To hide My Tasks, remove the user's Exchange Online license.

claims.claim: Removing the Exchange Online licence also removes the user's mailbox access.
claims.quote: It's important to know that after you remove an Exchange Online license, the user no longer has access to their mailbox.

claims.claim: The documented Teams Exchange Online licence workaround is not confirmed for this redesigned web experience.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner My Tasks web Exchange Online license hide private tasks storage redesigned. Read manage-planner-app and MC1488844; the hiding instructions concern the Teams app and do not specify the redesigned web experience.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: The page presents December 2026, including early December, as the arrival date of the changed interface.
claims.quote: General Availability (Worldwide): Rollout will occur from early through late December 2026 (previously November).
claims.fix: In the summary replace 'with a Worldwide rollout in December 2026' with 'with a Worldwide rollout scheduled for early through late December 2026 in MC1488844'. In Why it matters replace 'in the first weeks of December 2026' with 'during the scheduled rollout'. Replace 'Users will see a different My Tasks interface from early December 2026' with 'Microsoft schedules the updated My Tasks interface rollout for early through late December 2026 in MC1488844'.
